meta.name: block-no-verify-hook
meta.description: Configure a PreToolUse hook to prevent AI agents from skipping git pre-commit hooks with --no-verify and other bypass flags. Use when setting up Claude Code projects that enforce commit quality gates.

copy.tagline: 禁止 AI 代理绕过 Git 提交检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude Code 项目中强制提交质量检查。
copy.tagline_en: Block AI agents from skipping pre-commit checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce commit quality gates in Claude Code projects.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在项目中执行 Bash 命令前会先被检查:含 git --no-verify 或 --no-gpg-sign 的命令会被拦截并报错,其余命令照常执行。
howto.when: 在配置了该 hook 的 Claude Code 项目里,每当 Claude 要运行 Bash 命令时触发检查,尤其是执行 git commit、push、merge 等命令时。
howto.what_en: After setup, Claude Code inspects each Bash command before it runs: commands containing git --no-verify or --no-gpg-sign are blocked with an error message, while other commands run normally.
howto.when_en: Triggers on every Bash tool call in a project where the hook is configured, most relevant when Claude tries git commit, push, or merge.

say_en.text: Add the block-no-verify hook to my .claude/settings.json
say_en.note: Writes a hook config that blocks bypass flags

say_en.text: Also add this hook to my global ~/.claude/settings.json
say_en.note: All projects will then block bypass flags

say_en.text: Test the hook by running git commit --no-verify -m "test"
say_en.note: That command should be blocked with an error
